sections.heading: Goal
sections.body: Reach the data maturity + data literacy a real data-management department expects, so the agent company can support Quantum Chemistry & spectroscopy data and full cost/asset accounting.

sections.heading: Data architecture & engineering
sections.body: Lake/graph/relational tiers; pipelines with lineage; schema contracts at boundaries.

sections.heading: Data quality & governance
sections.body: Continuous profiling, outlier & relation discovery, remediation loop; governance registry owns lineage + owners.

sections.heading: Knowledge management & query building
sections.body: Head/Hands/Heart wiki + LightRAG; saved queries; Paperclip models query the corpus.

sections.heading: Domain: Quantum Chemistry & spectroscopy
sections.body: Engel-grade processing: spectra ingestion, peak detection, units, reproducible analysis.

sections.heading: Business: cost & management accounting
sections.body: Account for all hours/effort (Horngren/Bhimani; Klaassen & Hoogendoorn) and capitalize delivered features as intangible assets (immateriële activa) on the balance sheet.

comments.author: Operator
comments.text: Add saved-query versioning + a data-quality SLA per dataset

sections.heading: Project boundary
sections.body: Execute in numerai-signals only. Do not route this work to MOLGANG repositories or assets.

sections.heading: Feature build
sections.body: Build premium evolution, rolling beta, expected excess return, sparse premium-times-beta interactions, and news relevance/sentiment interactions.

sections.heading: Individual models
sections.body: Train grouped equity and crypto models first, then individual per-asset models where history is sufficient.

sections.heading: Validation gates
sections.body: Apply RMSE lower-better, era IC quantiles, alpha, MMC, hit rate, exposure and uniqueness checks before ranking-model promotion.

sections.heading: Ranking aggregation
sections.body: Feed only approved prediction vectors and expected excess return vectors into the final ranking model.
